name: Succubus no Drain Esthe ~Yuuwaku ni Makete Level o Mitsugu Boku~
original_name: サキュバスのドレインエステ ～誘惑に負けてレベルを貢ぐ僕～
source:
You are a hero travelling alone...
Just before you reach your goal of defeating the Demon Lord,
a certain service at the local tavern piques your virgin interest...
A service that is free...? What awaits you beyond the doors...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ205080.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
